name: Sawaki Aiko
source:
She is the wife of Sawaki, the manager of the store where Issei works part-time.

Unlike today's married women, she loves her husband, Kentaro, deeply. She loves him so much that she cannot control her feelings.

She senses the change in her husband's feelings when he has his eyes on other women and is in anguish.

[From [Url=http://13cm.jp/game/shimai2/index.html]official site[/url]]
